cause_quote: The introducing diff added `maybeAutoDisableCronJobAfterRunFailure({ … error: STARTUP_INTERRUPTED_ERROR … })` to startup recovery, sending the already incremented interruption count through the new ten-failure auto-disable check.
user_saw: A recurring automation could stop running after a Gateway restart or operator cancellation pushed its failure streak to ten.
summary: The fix excludes interruptions from failure streaks, auto-disable, and failure notifications while preserving completed job failures when webhook delivery is canceled.
reasoning: The parent of #118113 already incremented the failure streak during startup recovery and only directly disabled interrupted one-shots there. The #118113 diff introduced recurring-job auto-disable and fed those interruption counts into it from day one, with a test in the same commit expecting a restart interruption to disable a recurring job whose streak was nine.
